# Driversnote

> Driversnote is an automatic mileage tracking app that helps drivers maintain IRS-compliant logs and maximize tax deductions through GPS and Bluetooth-based trip logging.

Driversnote provides both individual and fleet management solutions for tracking business mileage, calculating tax deductions, and generating compliant documentation. The platform supports iOS and Android with automatic trip detection and integrates with IRS mileage reimbursement standards.

## Key Topics

- Automatic mileage tracking
- IRS compliance
- Tax deductions
- GPS tracking
- Mileage reimbursement

## Core Features

- [Automated Mileage Tracking](https://www.driversnote.com/tracking): GPS-based automatic trip logging and mileage tracking with intelligent trip detection
- [Mileage Reporting & Documentation](https://www.driversnote.com/reporting): Generate tax-compliant mileage reports and electronic documentation for trips
- [iBeacon Bluetooth Tracking](https://www.driversnote.com/ibeacon): Alternative automatic mileage logging using Bluetooth beacon technology
- [How It Works](https://www.driversnote.com/how-it-works): Feature overview and usage guide for automatic trip logging in Driversnote

## Team & Fleet Management

- [Fleet Management for Teams](https://www.driversnote.com/for-teams): Team mileage tracking with reimbursement tools and fleet management capabilities

## IRS Compliance & Tax Guides

- [IRS Mileage Reimbursement Guide 2026](https://www.driversnote.com/irs-mileage-guide): Comprehensive guide to IRS mileage reimbursement rates and regulations for 2026
- [Self-Employed Tax Deductions](https://www.driversnote.com/irs-mileage-guide/self-employed-deductions): IRS mileage deduction rules for self-employed using Schedule C and 1099 forms
- [Calculate Mileage Reimbursements](https://www.driversnote.com/irs-mileage-guide/calculate-reimbursement): Calculator and guide for mileage reimbursement using IRS rates and FAVR method
- [Small Business Tax Deductions Guide](https://www.driversnote.com/small-business-tax-guide-us): Comprehensive IRS tax deduction guide for self-employed and small business owners
- [IRS-Compliant Mileage Log Tips](https://www.driversnote.com/blog/how-to-keep-an-irs-compliant-mileage-log-book): Best practices for maintaining IRS-compliant mileage logs and maximizing tax deductions
